name: Korpus
summary: Single writer for my personal-data spine. Validates records against JSON Schemas, stores them in SQLite, acknowledges a write only after commit.
signal: One write boundary, acked writes, safe retries.

name: Pularis
summary: Stateless Go polling adapter. Config-driven HTTP fetcher that transforms API responses into Redis events. No persistence inside.
signal: Fetch, transform, emit. Stateless by design.

name: Kor
summary: Small Go TCP message router. Services register handlers, publish events, and call each other by name through a compact framed protocol.

name: Kron
summary: Go host for sandboxed Lua connectors and automations, triggered by time or by an event, with a run record for every execution.
signal: Automations as small Lua files in git.

name: Bober
summary: Small coding agent in one Go process. Speaks the Agent Client Protocol, runs a model loop with two basic tools, and everything else is a Lua extension.

name: Veles
summary: A memory store for AI agents that maintains itself: probation for inferred facts, checked writes and nightly tidying, in one Go binary and one SQLite file.
signal: Memory that curates itself through use.

name: Simmer
summary: Replacement software for the Monsieur Cuisine Connect kitchen robot: tested motor safety, a phone companion, Home Assistant and an API for agents.

name: Krution
summary: Read-mostly web UI for the Kor stack: Kron jobs and runs, Korpus records and a live tail of Kor events, in one Go binary.
signal: See the whole stack at a glance.

name: period
summary: Tiny self-hosted cycle tracker: one stdlib-only Go binary, one JSON file, no accounts and no external calls.
signal: Personal health data stays at home.

name: Futura
summary: Diploma project. My scope was the ML pipeline: Python/Jupyter with TA-Lib indicators, RFE feature selection, LightGBM classifier for next-day stock trends, MongoDB writeback.
signal: ML workflow execution, not a trading system claim.
